newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tai Kok Tsui Phase 2 consortium sets HK$8 bln loan.
newsitem.headline: Tai Kok Tsui Phase 2 consortium sets HK$8 bln loan.

text.p: A HK$8 billion loan for a property consortium involved in Hong Kong's Mass Transit Railway Corp development at the Tai Kok Tsui Station Package Two site is in general syndication, bankers said on Thursday.
The borrower is Benefit Bright Ltd, a vehicle of the consortium, which comprises Sino Land Co Ltd, Kerry Properties Ltd, China Overseas Land and Investment Ltd and the Bank of China group.
HSBC Investment Bank Asia, China Development Finance Co, Hang Seng Bank, WestLB, Deutsche Bank, Societe Generale and BA Asia are arranging the deal, bankers said.
The facility has a final maturity of four years with no put or call options.
It pays a margin of 140 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 160 basis points.
Proceeds are to be used for financing the property development of Tai Kok Tsui Station Package Two, one of many projects associated with Hong Kong's new Chek Lap Kok airport.
